- [USER] The user is looking for a mid-range wireless mouse.
- [USER] The user inquired about the battery life of the Logitech MX Anywhere 2S.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant stated that the Logitech MX Anywhere 2S has a rechargeable battery that can last up to 70 days on a single charge.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that real-world usage may vary, with an expected battery life of around 40-60 days with moderate to heavy use.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned the "Smart Sleep" feature of the MX Anywhere 2S that helps conserve battery life.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant highlighted the quick charging feature of the MX Anywhere 2S, providing up to 3 hours of use with just a 1-minute charge.
- [USER] The user asked about the sensor accuracy of the Logitech MX Anywhere 2S compared to other mice in the same range.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant described the MX Anywhere 2S's high-precision optical sensor with a resolution of up to 4,000 CPI.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant compared the MX Anywhere 2S to the Razer Viper Mini, which has a resolution of up to 16,000 CPI but is a wired mouse.
